t: A palm-sized RK3588 server board built to stack into clusters.
steps: Buy the Blade 3 from the Mixtile store or a US seller such as DigiKey or Ameridroid.
Get a USB-C PD charger, a network cable, and a microSD card.
Download Mixtile OS for Ubuntu or Debian from the Blade 3 docs.
Write the image to the card with a free tool such as balenaEtcher.
Plug in power and a network cable, then log in over SSH.
Update the system and check the NPU tools in the docs.
Try running a small web server as your first project.
meta: Open Board. From $229. A few stores.
